DETROIT


, Nov. 12, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Dauch Corporation (NYSE:DCH , LSE: DCH) will host a Capital Markets Day on November 17, 2026. David C. Dauch, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and members of the executive management team will provide an update on the company's business.


A live webcast will be accessible starting at 9:00 AM ET through the Dauch Capital Markets Day microsite ([www.dauchcapitalmarketsday.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820505-1&h=237751415&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dauchcapitalmarketsday.com%2F&a=www.dauchcapitalmarketsday.com) ). A replay of the webcast will be available following the event.


**About Dauch** Dauch Corporation is a premier Driveline and Metal Forming supplier serving the global automotive industry with a powertrain-agnostic product portfolio that supports electric, hybrid, and internal combustion vehicles. The company is headquartered in Detroit, MI, with operations that span 24 countries and more than 175 locations. Visit[www.dauch.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4820505-1&h=813485993&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dauch.com%2F&a=www.dauch.com) to learn more.
